title: 第2521章 末日系统五58第2520章 末日系统五57
content_zh:
伏羲的反馈是：“你可以理解为，结果全对，过程全错，错大于对，它照样会崩。”
韩紫枫吐槽：“这么容易崩啊，那本破书需要再教育哈。”
这下伏羲和将臣都挺无语的，岛国的游玩，由于金未来提前变成僵尸，所以结束的没有任何意外，包括游志杰在内，打架一起返回嘉嘉大厦。
现在的情况，打架本来就都知道，况国华代替况天佑成为一只僵尸，所以现在王珍珍是全力跟司徒奋仁一起，主打一个超自然时间，跟他们没关系的态度。
司徒奋仁也能做到，有王珍珍万事足，本应该是因为选美一事儿，情绪低落，酒吧买醉的他根本不存在，虽然依旧被贬去做记者，可整个人的心态也都不一样了。
至于蓝大力，还是去挑衅了司徒奋仁，但完全是走流程感觉，一怕王珍珍投诉，二怕一群非人类，不开心滴滴打人，有马叮当在，保证没人给他们说和。
他们回来没两天，就遇到学生妹卖·身买球鞋事件，结果，这次又被王珍珍全程盯着，材料拍是拍了，但半路被王珍珍截胡了，所以报道出来的，完全是报道了个寂寞。也正式因为这样，女学生没跳楼，唯一受伤的就是司徒奋仁被开除了。
然后司徒奋仁开心的，跑去跟王珍珍一起，当老师去了。一下，皇极经世书表示不会了，这中间差的东西有点多吧？但一群人表示，看的很开心，至于其他人开心不开心，就跟他们没关系了。
现在的伏羲也挺无语的，看着这群人这么造，他都能感觉到皇极经世书的忧伤，就没一个按着剧本来的是吧？现在蓝大力还被将臣血印控制着，更是没感做多余的事情。
结果就导致，到目前为止，司徒奋仁都没发现自己的超能力。不过，紫枫叫马小玲跟王珍珍一声，王珍珍则已经通知司徒奋仁，他有超能力，但他的超能力用别人的健康，甚至死亡，换他指定某人的健康。
司徒奋仁听完，第一反应是：“这个技能太坑了吧？”
王珍珍的吐槽则是：“你比这个技能还坑。”司徒奋仁无语，感觉自己在女朋友这里，完全是差评三连啊。
另一边，原本况天佑应该死在英国，所以，有段是还魂，可这次况天佑是在港岛死的，并且还魂时间也过了，就这样，冷不丁的，嘉嘉大厦还是出现了鬼魂。一群非人类团体开心围观，别说，真就是况天佑。
况国华：“不是，你上来干嘛？”
况天佑：“不知道，天一黑，我就被刷新到嘉嘉大厦了，我也想知道，我上来干嘛？”
非人类小团体点头，确定了，估计又是皇极经世书强行挽尊。一群人跟下面的人混的也是很熟的，马小玲直接叫出升降梯叔叔，把况天佑往里一丢。
升降梯叔叔无语问：“不是，他怎么上来的？”
马小玲：“我们也想知道，不过不重要，麻烦给送下去就完事了。”等人走后，一群闲的有点无聊的家伙，决定再去打皇极经世书一顿，这是一眼没照到，就犯贱是吧！
现在伏羲都无语了，现在打天书已经是非人类小团体的娱乐啦。也正是因为司徒奋仁没疯狂使用治愈的能力，所以他那个脑癌是真没怎么养，但紫枫这边，则提前把事情叫王珍珍和司徒奋仁说了。
现在司徒奋仁的唯一感觉就是，他活的太难了有没有！！另外，魔星在大家的定点投喂下，可是比电视剧中要健康很多，至少不是一个严重衰老证的孩子，由于吃的饱，金未来和尼诺都活的很健康。

司徒奋仁在回家的路上，还是被蓝大力三人友情撞了，也第一次用异能，转移到僵尸的身上，当然，他脑子中的肿瘤，也一下大了不老少，一下他就感觉老坑了。
原本应该司徒奋仁进医院，然后王珍珍耐心鼓励劝导，但现在，一群人选择更简单的办法，直接跑去叫将臣给一口算了，主打一个放弃人生，只求真爱。
将臣看着司徒奋仁，说真心话也挺无语的，直接上来表示希望来一口，真的好吗？好在，他也是讲理的，真就当着众人把司徒奋仁变成了二代。
结果就是，再次出现，结果全对，过程全错，皇极经世书又，又，又被坑的去自检了。一群僵尸也发现了新的玩法，那就是这种，结果全对，过程全错，操作方法，就像是电脑中了木马病毒，还是那种隐藏型木马病毒，看着没问题，但就是对不上账。
这种情况下，天书不会选择重启，只是会自检问题，变成那种纯薅能量，但就是不知道哪里有问题的情况。看着就跟手机内存过高差不多，反正一群非人类表示，自己玩的很好，至于那本破书怎么样，关他们什么事情。
原本打架都觉得，事情告一段落，毕竟，魔星尼诺看着，没打算这么早出来的样子。再者，堂本静也被除去了，还是将臣亲自下手的，也就应该没什么闹事的才对。
可诡异的事情还是出现了，那就是真有人不给将臣面子，因为在梦中袭击他们的僵尸，还是出现了，诡异的是，居然还是堂本静。
紫枫好奇的问：“大叔你不行啊，这个货不是你亲自收的？那么梦里的是什么情况？”
将臣大叔明显也是个要脸的，听到这么大纰漏，也表示不开心啦，更叫他不开心的是，他也不知道，是那个不给他脸，居然把堂本静复活啦。最重要的是，他没感觉到，附近有多余的僵尸血的标记。
将臣质疑：“我没发现，附近有僵尸印记，也没有非管束外的僵尸印记。”
紫枫撇撇嘴说：“所以，又是破书给你上眼药是吧？”将臣顿时表示个跟不开心啦。
只是现在，不是讨论谁干的，更何况，闲着这个世界，能做到叫堂本静复活的，应该没多余的人，应该又是皇极经世书干了啥。
：8xiaoshuo。：wap.8xiaoshuo

Fuxi's feedback was: "You can understand that if the results are all right and the process is all wrong, and the mistakes are greater than the rights, it will still collapse."
Han Zifeng complained: "It breaks so easily. That broken book needs re-education."
Fuxi and the generals were speechless at this time. The trip to the island country ended without any surprises because Jin Future turned into a zombie in advance. Including You Zhijie, they fought and returned to Jiajia Building.
As for the current situation, everyone knew during the fight that Kuang Guohua replaced Kuang Tianyou and became a zombie, so now Wang Zhenzhen is fully working with Situ Fenren to focus on a supernatural time and an attitude that has nothing to do with them.
Situ Fenren can also do it. With Wang Zhenzhen, everything is fine. It should have been because of the beauty pageant that he was depressed and drunk at the bar. Although he was still demoted to be a reporter, his whole mentality was different.
As for Lan Dali, he still went to provoke Situ Fenren, but it was completely done according to the process. Firstly, he was afraid of Wang Zhenzhen's complaints, and secondly, he was afraid of a group of non-human beings who would not be happy and Didi would beat people. Ma Dingdang was there to ensure that no one would make peace with them.
Two days after they came back, they encountered an incident involving a student girl selling her body to buy sneakers. As a result, Wang Zhenzhen was watching the whole process again. The material was taken, but Wang Zhenzhen intercepted it halfway, so the report was completely lonely. Officially because of this, the female student did not jump off the building, and the only injured person was Situ Fenren who was expelled.
Then Situ Fenren happily ran to become a teacher with Wang Zhenzhen. After a while, Huangji Jingshishu said that he couldn't do it. There are a lot of differences in the middle, right? But a group of people said they enjoyed watching it, and whether other people were happy or not was none of their business.
Fuxi was quite speechless now. Seeing this group of people acting like this, he could feel the sadness of Huangji Jingshishu. None of them followed the script, right? Now that Lan Dali was still controlled by the general's blood seal, he didn't feel like doing unnecessary things.
As a result, Situ Fenren has not discovered his superpower so far. However, Zifeng asked Ma Xiaoling to talk to Wang Zhenzhen, and Wang Zhenzhen had informed Situ Fenren that he had super powers, but his super powers used the health of others, or even death, in exchange for the health of someone he designated.
After listening to this, Situ Fenren's first reaction was: "Isn't this skill too tricky?"
Wang Zhenzhen's complaint was: "You are worse than this skill." Situ Fenren was speechless, feeling that he had received three bad reviews from his girlfriend.
On the other hand, Kuang Tianyou was supposed to have died in the UK, so he was resurrected for a while, but this time Kuang Tianyou died in Hong Kong Island, and the time for his resurrection had passed. Just like that, suddenly, a ghost still appeared in Jiajia Building. A group of non-human groups happily watched, don't tell me, it was really Kuang Tianyou.
Kuang Guohua: "No, what are you doing here?"
Kuang Tianyou: "I don't know. As soon as it got dark, I was refreshed to Jiajia Building. I also want to know, why did I come up here?"
The small group of non-humans nodded and confirmed. It was probably Huangji Jingshishu who forcibly regained their respect. A group of people were very familiar with the people below. Ma Xiaoling directly called out the elevator uncle and threw Kuang Tianyou in.
The elevator uncle asked speechlessly: "No, how did he get up?"
Ma Xiaoling: "We want to know too, but it's not important. Please just send it down and we'll be done with it." After the others left, a group of idle and bored guys decided to go beat up Huang Ji Jing Shi Shu again. It's a shame not to take a look at it, right?
Now Fuxi is speechless. Nowadays, reading the Book of Heaven has become the entertainment of a small group of non-human beings. It was precisely because Situ Fenren didn't use his healing ability crazily that his brain cancer was really not cured. However, Zifeng told Wang Zhenzhen and Situ Fenren about the matter in advance.
Situ Fenren's only feeling now is that his life is too difficult, isn't it? ! In addition, the magic star is at everyone’s designated spotAfter being fed, he is much healthier than in the TV series. At least he is not a child with severe aging syndrome. Because they are well fed, both Jin Mirai and Nino are living very healthily.
On the way home, Situ Fenren was bumped into by Lan Dali and the other three. He also used his powers for the first time to transfer to a zombie. Of course, the tumor in his brain suddenly grew bigger, and he suddenly felt like he was in a trap.
Originally, Situ Fenren should have been admitted to the hospital, and Wang Zhenzhen would have patiently encouraged and persuaded him. But now, a group of people chose a simpler way and went directly to ask the general to give up on him. They mainly wanted to give up life and only seek true love.
The general looked at Situ Fenren and was quite speechless to tell the truth. He came up directly to express his hope for a bite. Is that really okay? Fortunately, he was also reasonable and actually turned Situ Fenren into the second generation in front of everyone.
The result was that, once again, the results were all right, the process was all wrong, and the Huangji Jingshi Book was tricked into self-examination again. A group of zombies also discovered a new way to play, which is this. The results are all right, but the process is all wrong. The operation method is like a computer infected with a Trojan virus, or a hidden Trojan virus. It looks fine, but it just doesn't work.
In this case, Tianshu will not choose to restart, but will self-check the problem, turning into the kind of situation where the energy is pure, but it just doesn't know where the problem is. It looked like the memory of a mobile phone was too high. Anyway, a group of non-human beings said that they had a good time. As for the broken book, it was none of their business.
At first I thought the fight was over, but after all, Demon Star Nino looked at him and didn't seem to intend to come out so early. Furthermore, Domoto Shizu was also removed, and it was done by the general himself, so there should be no trouble.
But a strange thing still happened, that is, there were really people who didn't give face to the generals, because the zombie that attacked them in the dream still appeared, and the strange thing was that it was Domoto Shizu.
Zifeng asked curiously: "Uncle, you can't do it. You didn't collect this product yourself? So what was going on in the dream?"
Uncle General is obviously a shameless person, and he was not happy when he heard such a big mistake. What made him even more unhappy was that he didn't know that it was the one who didn't give him any face, but actually resurrected Domoto Shizu. Most importantly, he didn't feel any signs of excess zombie blood nearby.
The general questioned: "I didn't find any zombie marks nearby, and there were no zombie marks outside the control area."
Zifeng pouted and said, "So, it's Poshu giving you eye drops again, right?" The general immediately expressed his displeasure.
But now, we are not discussing who did it. What's more, in this world, there should be no redundant person who can resurrect Domoto Shizu. It should be Huangji Jingshishu who did it.
